verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is self-hosted and can run entirely offline or air-gapped, meaning users control their own infrastructure and data never has to leave it or be sent to a vendor for training — a strong structural guarantee against training-data use. Evidence supports offline/local-model operation and air-gapped deployment, but there's no explicit policy statement addressing third-party cloud model providers' training use when those APIs are connected. Missing for 10: explicit documentation addressing opt-out/training policy when using external OpenAI-compatible cloud APIs, independent confirmation of data-handling guarantees.
